I'm Joey (Wonhyung) Choi, an MSc Biology student at the University of Zurich. I work on **single-cell chromatin accessibility**: scATAC-seq and multiome (RNA + ATAC) sequencing. I do both the bench work and the analysis, so I call myself a *wet-dry hybrid*.

Outside the lab I co-founded **type\_**, a dating app, so some posts here will be about building software too.

## Why a blog?

Writing things down is how I check that I actually understand them. This is where those notes go:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[🧪 bench] --> B[💻 analysis]
  B --> C[📝 write it up]
  C -.-> A
```

## What to expect

- Methods explained with diagrams — I learn visually
- Pipelines and the mistakes I made building them
- The occasional note on shipping an app
